info.title: Amazon Business API for Order History
info.description: With Amazon Business API for Order History, you can analyze your order and supplier data, track shipments, and track progress towards your spending goals.

externalDocs.description: Learn more about the Amazon Business API.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of orders with order dates that fall within the date range that you specify. You can optionally retrieve lineItem, charges, and shipments for these orders.

**Usage Plan:**

| Rate (requests per second) | Burst |
| ---- | ---- |
| 0.5 | 10 |

The `x-amzn-RateLimit-Limit` response header returns the usage plan rate limits that were applied to the requested operation. The preceding table indicates the default rate and burst values for this operation. For questions about your usage plan, reach out to your Amazon Business technical contact.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The lower limit for the search range. This date represents the order date.

parameters.name: nextPageToken
parameters.description: A page token returned in the response to your previous request when the number of results exceed the page size (100). To get the next page of results, include nextPageToken as the only parameter. There are no more pages to return when the response returns no nextPageToken. This token needs to be encoded.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The upper limit for the search range. This date represents the order date.

parameters.name: includeLineItems
parameters.description: An option to get all line items associated with the order.

parameters.name: includeShipments
parameters.description: An option to get all shipments associated with the order.

parameters.name: includeCharges
parameters.description: An option to get all charges associated with the order.

get.description:
API to fetch details for a specific order based on order identifier. You can optionally retrieve lineItem, charges, and shipments for this order.

**Usage Plan:**

| Rate (requests per second) | Burst |
| ---- | ---- |
| 0.5 | 10 |

The `x-amzn-RateLimit-Limit` response header returns the usage plan rate limits that were applied to the requested operation. The preceding table indicates the default rate and burst values for this operation. For questions about your usage plan, reach out to your Amazon Business technical contact.

parameters.description: The unique identifier for an order to get the corresponding order details.

Order.description: The response schema for the getOrdersByDates and getOrdersById operations.

orderDate.description: The date when the order was placed.

orderId.description: Amazon auto-generated identifier for the order.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: The Purchase Order Number assigned to the order.

orderQuantity.description: The item quantity relevant to this order.

lastOrderApproverName.description: The name of the last person who approved the order.

buyingCustomer.description: The requisitioner or buyer who placed the order.

buyerGroupName.description: The group within the business from which the order was placed.

orderSubTotal.description: The principal amount on the order. This only includes the price and excludes shipping, taxes, or discounts.

orderShippingAndHandling.description: The total shipping charges on the order. This excludes shipment tax and discounts.

orderPromotion.description: The total discount on the order. This includes discounts on items and shipping. We don't show shipping discounts separately for each individual order.

orderTax.description: The total taxes for the order.

orderNetTotal.description: The total amount charged for the order.

Charge.description: The charged amount and the payment details for the order.

transactionDate.description: The date when the payment was processed.

transactionId.description: The transaction reference identifier for the transaction.

amount.description: The amount charged for a particular transaction. This is the amount for which Amazon received an authorization if the transaction isn’t settled yet.

paymentInstrumentType.description: Credit card, Pay by Invoice, Bank Account, Reward Account.

paymentInstrumentLast4Digits.description: The last 4 digits of the payment card used in the transaction. If Pay by Invoice was used, this value is null.

Customer.description: A customer with a role in a purchase such as buyer, payer, or approver.

id.description: [DEPRECATED: This field always returns an empty string.] The unique customer identifier internal to Amazon.

orders.description: The orders for the orderId or given date range.

nextPageToken.description: A page token returned in the response to your previous request when the number of results exceed the page size (100). To get the next page of results, include nextPageToken as the only parameter. There are no more pages to return when the response returns no nextPageToken. This token needs to be encoded.

size.description: The quantity of orders returned in the current response.

LineItem.description: A line item in an order.

productCategory.description: The Amazon Business category for the product.

asin.description: The Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN) for the product.

unspsc.description: The United Nations Standard Products and Services Code for the product.

productCondition.description: The condition of the product purchased such as new, used, or used good.

listedPricePerUnit.description: The listed price for each unit.

purchasedPricePerUnit.description: The price for each purchased unit.

itemSubTotal.description: The base amount paid for an item. This excludes shipping and handling, tax, promotions, and discounts.

itemShippingAndHandling.description: The base amount paid for shipping and handling an item. This excludes tax and discount amounts.

itemPromotion.description: The total discounts and promotions applied to an item. This includes all discount components such as discount on price, shipping, gift wrapping, or other fees. This excludes tax.

itemTax.description: The tax charged for an item.

itemNetTotal.description: The total amount charged for an item. This includes shipping and handling, tax, discounts, and item price.

purchaseOrderLineItem.description: Applicable only to customers who are using Punchout.

taxExemptionApplied.description: Indicates if tax exemption was applied.

taxExemptionType.description: Specifies the type of tax exemption applied.

taxExemptOptOut.description: Indicates if tax exemption was opted out.
